name: mcp-remote-macos-use
notes: Python MCP server published by baryhuang and distributed as the Docker image buryhuang/mcp-remote-macos-use; the target Mac needs only Screen Sharing enabled, with host, username and password passed as environment variables. Its own RFB client (src/vnc_client.py) supports only Apple Authentication (protocol 30). server.py registers eight tools: remote_macos_get_screen (a PNG screenshot), send_keys, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_double_click, mouse_scroll, mouse_drag_n_drop and open_application; action handlers scale the client's coordinates to the remote screen size, and open_application types the app name into Spotlight (Command+Space, text, Return). An optional LiveKit handler adds WebRTC screen sharing when LiveKit variables are set. The server has no model of its own; the MCP client's model decides the actions. Root LICENSE is MIT (copyright peakmojo); the default branch was last committed on 30 April 2025.
summary: MCP server that lets an LLM client such as Claude Desktop control a remote Mac through its built-in Screen Sharing, returning screenshots and sending scaled mouse, keyboard, scroll and drag actions over VNC.
